Eighth Circuit Maintains Roundup Settlement Path
: Eighth Circuit rejected objectors' challenge to Bayer AG's Roundup state‑court class settlement, keeping Missouri jurisdiction and preserving the pathway to a September final‑approval hearing.
Bayer Files In Japan For Kerendia Expansion
: Bayer (BAYN) filed in Japan to expand Kerendia (finerenone) for non‑diabetic chronic kidney disease after positive Phase III FIND‑CKD trial results; submission seeks regulatory approval.
Bayer Releases REVEAL Results For Iodine-124
: Bayer AG (BAYN) released Phase III REVEAL results for iodine-124 evuzamitide PET tracer for cardiac amyloidosis; data presented at ESC 2026 and published in JAMA.
